features: OBOOK 5:Your ideal companion for an immersive reading experience. With advanced E-paper HD Screen technology and an impressive 219 dpi resolution, this e-reader delivers crisp, clear text that mimics the appearance of printed paper, ensuring a comfortable, glare-free reading experience, even in dark environments.

The OBOOK 5 e-reader is equipped with a state-of-the-art mobile electronic paper display and adjustable front light, allowing you to customize your reading environment to suit any lighting condition, whether you're enjoying a book during the day or relaxing at night.
With its smart button feature, browsing your library has never been easier; just tap to turn pages, access menus, and explore content effortlessly.

Enjoy your favorite audiobooks wherever you are! The OBOOK 5 includes a built-in speaker that allows you to easily switch between reading and listening. Connect via Wi-Fi or Bluetooth to download new titles, stream audiobooks, or sync your notes and highlights across devices.

With an impressive battery life, the OBOOK 5 e-reader ensures you read without interruption for weeks on a single charge. It recharges easily thanks to its convenient USB-C port, making it perfect for travel or daily commuting.
description: An advanced electronic reader with HD anti-glare display for electronic paper, 219 dpi resolution, adjustable front light and long battery life. Enjoy audiobooks with built-in speakers, seamless Wi-Fi and Bluetooth connectivity, and USB support for easy file transfer. Perfect for reading anywhere!
